scientific_integrity: Self-contained infinite proof and standalone direct finite incidence enumeration. The finite enumeration does not certify the infinite statement. Previous k=2 classification is prior art, not claimed as new. No independent external audit or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Valid only for integer k>=3 and n>=2k, for the standard k-rainbow domination on labeled crown graphs with distinguishable colors; n<2k is not covered. The 2018 conference abstract on 3-rainbow crown domination leaves a residual literature coverage risk.
title: Sharp support transition for minimum \(k\)-rainbow domination of crown graphs
